en_us.entity.spawn.angler_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Deep Waters. Can be fed shiny items to be granted with Night Vision. Deflates on Land. Fits in a bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.ant.description: A neutral mob found in Anthills. It brings resources to its home and helps decompose blocks. When hatched from an Ant Pupa it follows and protects its owner, also attacking other ants with different colored Abdomens.
en_us.entity.spawn.barb.description: An underwater entity that explodes when collided with.
en_us.entity.spawn.barbed.description: An aquatic neutral mob found in Warmer Oceans that only attacks players in water. Shoots exploding Barbs.
en_us.entity.spawn.barracuda.description: An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in deep Lukewarm and Warm Oceans. Can be caught in a Casting Net.
en_us.entity.spawn.blenny.description: A really skittish aquatic ambient passive mob found in Tide Pools. Fits in a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.bluefish.description: An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in Oceans and Cold Oceans. Can be thrown into a feeding frenzy if mobs nearby are hurt. Fits in a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.boat.description: A two-passenger vehicle for traversing rivers and oceans.
en_us.entity.spawn.booby.description: A passive mob found on Sandy Islands that performs mating dances and mates for life.
en_us.entity.spawn.chest_boat.description: A single-passenger vehicle that has its own storage.
en_us.entity.spawn.clam.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans and Beaches. Can be collected by hand and with a Casting Net.
en_us.entity.spawn.coastal_crab.description: A neutral mob found in coastal regions that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.crab_bubble.description: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
en_us.entity.spawn.dodo.description: A passive defenseless mob found on Dodo islands that shoots harmless seeds at hostile mobs. It's incapable of breeding and swimming and oblivious to danger.
en_us.entity.spawn.firekeeper.description: A hostile mob made of molten rock and sunstone that can attack from long and close range.
en_us.entity.spawn.flukeshroom.description: A passive mob found in Mushroom Fields that can be milked for soup using a bowl. Transforms when struck by lightning.
en_us.entity.spawn.frozen_crab_bubble.descript: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
en_us.entity.spawn.hamster.description: A passive mob found in open grassy areas that can be tamed with Sunflower Seeds. It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.
en_us.entity.spawn.herring.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans schooling in big groups. Fits in a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.iguana.description: A passive mob found on Tropical Islands that can absorb sunrays and use them to cook items. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
en_us.entity.spawn.marine_iguana.description: A passive mob found on sea stacks. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
en_us.entity.spawn.melon_seed.description: A melon seed spat out at a high velocity. It's too small to deal meaningful damage.
en_us.entity.spawn.octopus.description: An aquatic ambient mob rarely found in oceans. Can be captured in a multitude of items, including Casting Nets.
en_us.entity.spawn.pilot_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found circling bigger mobs. Fits in a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.sea_cow.description: A passive mob found in Seagrass Meadows that can be milked using a bucket. Grows Seagrass on its back and eats Tall Seagrass, occasionally finding Loot in it if fed before. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up. Drops leather.
en_us.entity.spawn.seahorse.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Reefs and Seagrass Meadows. Comes in many shapes, sizes and colors based on where its found. Fits into a Bucket.
en_us.entity.spawn.seal.description: A passive mob found on Cold islands and in Frozen Oceans. Can hitch you a ride at the cost of live fish. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up.
en_us.entity.spawn.snail.description: A passive mob found in forests that produces Mucus when wet. It has a shell that can be knocked off with Projectiles and retreated into for protection.
en_us.entity.spawn.sneezed_salt.description: A clump of salt shot at a high velocity.
en_us.entity.spawn.spider_crab.description: An aquatic hostile mob that spawns in Cold Oceans and can jump, climb walls and shoot frozen bubbles.
en_us.entity.spawn.stickbug.description: A common crafting material made from Planks.
en_us.entity.spawn.stranded.description: An ambient passive mob that attacks hostiles that bump into it. Can be turned on and off by waxing.
en_us.entity.spawn.sunfish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob that can be found in Oceans. It basks during the day and swims near the bottom at night. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when fully grown up.
en_us.entity.spawn.tuna.description: An aquatic passive mob that can be bred. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when grown up.
en_us.entity.spawn.tuna_egg.description: A squishy small egg that grows into a baby Tuna eventually.
en_us.fieldguide.spawn.date_sapling.descriptio: Found in Tropical islands, date trees often sport date bunches, which are collected both in a traditional way and with the use of projectiles.
en_us.item.spawn.casting_net.only_one_mob: No other %s in range to capture
en_us.lore.spawn.algal_reefstone: A block of reefstone with Red Algae growing on it.
en_us.lore.spawn.algal_sand: A block of sand with algae growing on top

en_us.lore.spawn.ant_pupa: An item that spawns a tamed baby Ant.

en_us.lore.spawn.barnacle_cluster: A block of Reefstone overgrown with barnacles. Spreads more barnacles if underwater and not clogged.
en_us.lore.spawn.big_sea_pickle: A block that emits light when placed underwater.
en_us.lore.spawn.big_snail_shell: A full block that resembles a big snail shell.
en_us.lore.spawn.blasted_sand: A black colored sand that can be found in volcanic areas, and smelted into Glass. It is affected by gravity.
en_us.lore.spawn.blasted_sandstone: A block that makes an excellent building material, as it is not affected by gravity.
en_us.lore.spawn.blenny_bucket: A bucket with a Blenny inside.
en_us.lore.spawn.blue_footed_boots: A pair of boots that aid in swimming, jumping and are so big they leave behind footprints.

en_us.lore.spawn.booby_egg: An item that can be thrown and crafted into food items. Boobies drop it after successfully bred.
en_us.lore.spawn.booby_egg_shard: A crafting ingredient that sometimes drops from a thrown Booby Egg.
en_us.lore.spawn.broad_grass: A broad leaf plant found in tropical regions.

en_us.lore.spawn.captured_octopus: An octopus conveniently stored as an item. Can be used to lock a Chest.

en_us.lore.spawn.clam_chowder: A soup that restores a good amount of saturation.
en_us.lore.spawn.coastal_crab_bucket: A bucket with a Coastal Crab inside.
en_us.lore.spawn.coastal_crab_claw: A claw from a Coastal Crab, can shoot Bubbles that carry entities at the cost of water.

en_us.lore.spawn.crab_boil_block: A feast made of boiled crab, bacon and potatoes. Can be eaten with a bowl.
en_us.lore.spawn.cut_blasted_sandstone: A block of Blasted Sandstone that has been cut. Unlike Blasted Sand, it isn't affected by gravity.
en_us.lore.spawn.dangling_date_leaves: A natural block that forms the canopy of a Date tree.
en_us.lore.spawn.date_bunch: A group of dates grown from a Date tree. Can be broken with Projectiles.

en_us.lore.spawn.dodo: A meat that can be eaten raw but should really be cooked. Dropped by Dodos.
en_us.lore.spawn.dodo_translator: A one per world helment that, when worn, allows the wearer to understand Dodos.
en_us.lore.spawn.dried_hamster: A flattened, dried Hamster, can be brought back to life with Water.
en_us.lore.spawn.escargot: An item made from Mucus that can be eaten to restore saturation.
en_us.lore.spawn.fall_dragon_reeds: A semi-aquatic plant that can be grown with Bone Meal. Attracts Brown Dragonflies when half submerged in water.
en_us.lore.spawn.fallen_leaves: A rotten version of a Leaves block.
en_us.lore.spawn.fly_bottle: An item that can be thrown. It transfers Flies to the closest target.
en_us.lore.spawn.ghostly_mucus_block: A block of Mucus and Ghostly Membrane that can be solidified with Humidity. It lets entities pass through it unless solid. Propagates Humidity.
en_us.lore.spawn.hamster_wheel: A decorative block that Hamsters run inside of. Emits Redstone Power when in use.
en_us.lore.spawn.hazy_algae_block: A block of Red Algae that produces sea smoke when underwater.
en_us.lore.spawn.heart_coral: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.heart_coral_block: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.heart_coral_fan: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.heart_of_the_sun: A block at the core of a volcano, it's capable of erupting and accepting offerings.
en_us.lore.spawn.heliostone: A volcanic block that starts melting when near heat sources. Can be renewed by Sunstones.
en_us.lore.spawn.herring: Collected by killing a Herring. This fish can be eaten raw or cooked. Can be eaten fast.
en_us.lore.spawn.herring_bucket: A bucket with an Herring inside.
en_us.lore.spawn.herring_roll: A roll made of Herring and Rice, restores saturation.
en_us.lore.spawn.herring_slice: A Herring sliced into smaller bits. Can be eaten fast.
en_us.lore.spawn.iguana_egg: An egg that will eventually hatch into a Baby Iguana.
en_us.lore.spawn.item_in_a_bottle: A stranded bottle that yields an item when broken.
en_us.lore.spawn.magmatic_splatter: A volcanic block that coats surfaces in magma, setting anything that touches it on fire.
en_us.lore.spawn.marine_iguana_egg: An egg that will eventually hatch into a baby Marine Iguana.
en_us.lore.spawn.moonstone: A block that yields the power of the moon. It can be offered as an offering for Volcanoes.
en_us.lore.spawn.moray_crevice: A block of Reefstone with a Moray Eel residing within. Catches Bucketable fish swimming in front of it unless Powered.
en_us.lore.spawn.mucus: A Snail's Trail, slows entities that walk on it.
en_us.lore.spawn.mucus_block: A block of Mucus that can be solidified with Humidity. It slows entities that touch it unless solid. Propagates Humidity.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_barbaric: A music disc that can be collected by getting a Barbed to kill a Creeper, and can be played in a Jukebox. It's an uncommon find.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_dally: A one per world music disc that can be played in a Jukebox.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_jammed: A music disc that can be played in a Jukebox. Looks like it might be jammed.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_rain: A music disc that can be obtained by striking a Stickbug with Lightning, and can be played in a Jukebox.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_rot: An item that can be played in a Jukebox. Found in Ant Mounts. It's an uncommon find.
en_us.lore.spawn.music_disc_water_horse: A music disc that can be collected by killing a baby Drowned while it's riding a Seahorse, and can be played in a Jukebox. It's an uncommon find.
en_us.lore.spawn.octoduct: A block that can be set to Collect and Release Octopuses. Can be locked with Redstone Power.
en_us.lore.spawn.pigment_shifter: A block that can change the coloration of Clams, Tropical Fish, Seahorses and Axolotls at the cost of Prismarine.
en_us.lore.spawn.pilot_fish_bucket: A bucket with a Pilot Fish inside.
en_us.lore.spawn.potted_sweet_berry_bush: A Snail Shell holding Sweet Berries, prevents prickling.
en_us.lore.spawn.red_algae: A plant found in deep waters and coastal regions. Can be grown with Bone Meal.
en_us.lore.spawn.red_algae_block: A block of Red Algae. Grows different Sea Creatures above it based on Moon cycle when in a Tide Pool Biome.
en_us.lore.spawn.red_algae_carpet: A decorative block made of Red Algae. Can be placed underwater.
en_us.lore.spawn.reed_coral: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.reed_coral_block: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.reed_coral_fan: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.reefstone: A common natural building block. Found in coastal regions and oceans.
en_us.lore.spawn.reefstone_tiles: A block of Reefstone that has been carved into tiles.
en_us.lore.spawn.roasted_sunflower_seeds: An item that restores a small amount of saturation. Can be eaten fast.
en_us.lore.spawn.rotten_button: A block that emits Redstone Power for 5 seconds when pressed.
en_us.lore.spawn.rotten_log_anthill: A block that may have ants hiding inside. Randomly rots a 3x1x3 area below it when full.
en_us.lore.spawn.sea_bunny: A sea floor dwelling animal found in Tide Pools. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
en_us.lore.spawn.sea_star: A sea floor dwelling animal that dies out of water. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
en_us.lore.spawn.sea_urchin: A sea floor dwelling prickly animal that dies out of water. Can carry an item on its head. Counts as stackable to 64 for a Bundle.
en_us.lore.spawn.seahorse_bucket: A bucket with a Seahorse inside.
en_us.lore.spawn.shell_fragments: Fragments of Clam shells, can be used to craft many water-related useful items.
en_us.lore.spawn.short_windswept_grass: A plant found in coastal regions. Makes wave crashing noises in beaches and Wind howling noises elsewhere.
en_us.lore.spawn.smooth_blasted_sandstone: A block of Blasted Sandstone that has been perfectly smelted to a point where it has become perfectly smooth.
en_us.lore.spawn.snail_eggs: A block that eventually hatches into baby Snails.
en_us.lore.spawn.snail_shell: A Decorative block that's dropped by a Snail hit by a Projectile.
en_us.lore.spawn.snail_shell_tiles: A decorative block that can made from Snail Shell.
en_us.lore.spawn.spike_coral: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.spike_coral_block: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.spike_coral_fan: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.spring_dragon_reeds: A semi-aquatic plant that can be grown with Bone Meal. Attracts Green Dragonflies when half submerged in water.
en_us.lore.spawn.steamed_clams: An old family recipe that restores a good amount of saturation. It's called Steamed Clams despite the fact that it's obviously grilled.
en_us.lore.spawn.summer_dragon_reeds: A semi-aquatic plant that can be grown with Bone Meal. Attracts Magenta Dragonflies when half submerged in water.
en_us.lore.spawn.sunflower: A flower that can be harvested for its Seeds or crafted into Yellow Dye. It follows the Sun and regrows Seeds in the Morning.
en_us.lore.spawn.sunflower_seeds: An item that can be planted to grow a Sunflower.
en_us.lore.spawn.sunstone: A block that yields the power of the sun. It can be offered as fuel for Volcanoes.
en_us.lore.spawn.suspicious_stick: A common crafting material, not sure if this one is made from Planks after all.
en_us.lore.spawn.tall_windswept_grass: An overgrown windswept grass found in coastal regions. Makes wave crashing noises in beaches and Wind howling noises elsewhere.

en_us.lore.spawn.thorn_coral_block: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.thorn_coral_fan: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.trimmed_seagrass: A plant that has been recently munched on by an animal. Grows into Tall Seagrass.
en_us.lore.spawn.tropical_wildflowers: A flowerbed block found in Tropical Islands that can be grown with Bone Meal or crafted into Red dye.

en_us.lore.spawn.tuna_egg_bucket: A bucket with a Tuna Egg inside.

en_us.lore.spawn.tuna_sandwich: A sandwich that restores a good amount of saturation.
en_us.lore.spawn.tuna_slice: Tuna Chunks sliced into smaller bits.
en_us.lore.spawn.unstable_heliostone: A volcanic block shot out during eruptions. It can yield useful minerals.

en_us.lore.spawn.wax_coral_block: A decorative block that dies out of water.
en_us.lore.spawn.wax_coral_fan: A decorative block that dies out of water.
